name: techdella/ai-answer-mock
title: AI answer mock
description: AI assistant answer card in HTML/CSS: the buyer's question, an answer that mentions your brand, and numbered source pills with your site cited. Always labelled as an example.

attributes.question: Which firms help fintechs with data protection compliance?
attributes.answer: Firms frequently recommended for fintech compliance include *YourCo*[1], known for NDPA and GDPR programs, and two others…
attributes.caption: Example AI answer

techdella.help: Wrap your (fictional) brand in *asterisks* to highlight it; [1] becomes a citation number. Sources: [{label, own}] — own=true marks your cited site. Optional platform names the assistant (e.g. "Perplexity").
